scheme_name: Land Ports Authority Of India (LPAI) Internship Scheme
other_conditions: Must be an Indian student from a recognised university (in India or abroad) having at least 60% marks in the most recent degree or certificate examination

Must satisfy one of the specified education patterns: completion of 10+2+3 schooling, polytechnic diploma/degree, 4th year of engineering (10+2+4), MBA/PGDBM from premier institutes, 4th or 5th year of integrated/dual degree (10+2+5), 2nd year of Engineering or Science at any IIT/NIT, M.Tech/M.Eng./MCA from a prestigious institute, or 2nd year of law degree from a recognized law institute/university
Application must be sponsored by the candidate’s educational institution
Preference will be given to students from the Northeast region and wards of stakeholders deployed with LPAI
benefits_summary: A Certificate of Internship is issued upon successful completion of the program and acceptance of the submitted report.
